rev.t: Was searching for a team to shoot my brother's wedding. Was reluctant at first but when they delivered the movie we were moved emotionally.
Taken my short film script to them and the entire team helped me to get the script to life. Hats off to the cinematographer - his eye for details and aesthetics is top notch.
The best place for a film maker to be in... All my media requirements were met and delivered on time.
